face.title: Face recognition
face.loadFailed: Could not load your face enrollment.
face.intro: To punch in and out, your face is checked against three photos you take once. An admin approves them first.
face.consentedBody: You accepted the notice. Take your three photos to finish.
face.pendingBody: Photos sent {{when}} (IST). An admin will review them.
face.approvedBody: Your face is enrolled. You can punch in once everything else is ready.
face.rejected: Your photos were rejected. Enroll again.
face.reset: Your enrollment was reset. Enroll again.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.intro: Please read how your face is used. You can only punch in after you accept and an admin approves your photos.

collected.title: What we keep
collected.body: Three photos of your face, and a numeric template made from them. Each time you punch, a new selfie is compared with the template.

why.title: Why
why.body: To check that it is really you who punches in or out.

who.title: Who can see it
who.body: Admins who review enrollments and unclear matches can see your photos. Every time they open them, it is logged.

kept.title: How it is protected
kept.body: The template is encrypted. Photos are shown only through short-lived links.

deleted.title: When it is deleted
deleted.body: When you leave the company (after 30 days by default), or when an admin resets your enrollment.

devBuild.title: Needs the development build
devBuild.body: The camera is not available in Expo Go. Open the WorkTrack development build on an Android phone to enroll your face.

camera.permissionBody: WorkTrack uses the camera only to take your enrollment photos and, later, your punch selfie.
